title: Brand-aware agent review layer

intent.problem: Agent outputs drift from a defined brand across sessions
intent.desired_outcome: Provide a reusable review layer that detects and corrects brand drift before delivery
intent.actor: Creative and engineering teams using agentic clients

constraints: must use original brand assets when available

facts: Different sessions can start with different context
assumptions: A hybrid rules plus examples representation is sufficient for v1
unknowns: Which visual similarity checks are available in every target runtime

decisions.rationale: Rules cover hard constraints while examples preserve taste

risks: Overfitting to a small reference set

success_criteria: Valid fixtures are not falsely rejected

next_action: Write failing contract fixtures for allowed and disallowed brand outputs
